open_assumptions: The projects contract 1.3.0 keeps inputs.workers as an ordered array (node_id any lane id) with required_check_kinds, plus selected_workers and excluded_workers on inputs; finding worker and requirement_found_in are strings; contract_version is the literal '1.3.0' for review and inputs payloads. This matches the adapter worktree's contracts/projects/v1.ts as of this handoff.

1.3.0 exports keep per-lane state under values.lanes[<id>] and values.packets[<id>] (PRD section 4); the adapter's server reads both this and the flat legacy keys, so the seeds use the nested shape only.

A 1.2.0 export projects to contract 1.3.0 with selected_workers = every listed lane, excluded_workers = [] and required_check_kinds derived from the role (frontend: build, browser; backend: unit), as verification.py did before policy 1.2.0.

The new runs live in a separate registered workflow (lanes-flow) in the same project so the feature-flow run list and the existing scenarios' counts are untouched; the one-lane run is a --workers docs subset of the three-lane policy.

The lane's own worker-phase verification (build and browser checks on this worktree in isolation) cannot pass until the adapter's contract change is present; the candidate phase combining both lanes is where these checks are expected to pass.
